name: Eighty-Three
description: 83: trick-taking game; first to 83 points (or similar target) wins. Trump and follow-suit rules; point cards in tricks. Exact rules vary by region (e.g. Indian 83).

history.origins: American Pedro family; 83 played with 53 cards (52 + joker). Joker = lowest trump worth 15; trump 3 worth 0. North-east USA and Canada; same deal/bid as 63.
timeline: 20th century: Pedro/83 variant documented in North America.

rules.objective: Bid and make at least the bid in trick points. 83 points in deck (with joker); first to game target wins.
rules.gameplay: Like 63: 9 cards, bid, discard non-trumps, dealer replenishes to 6. Joker = lowest trump (15 pts); trump 3 = 0. Only trumps score.
